answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake in escrow before it can earn: a jetty is only as strong as its pilings, and here the stake is the piling. A Sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents recover theirs. A jade seal on each stake — a signed cipher proving the funds are locked — lets peers verify cheaply and slash identities that misbehave, turning identity forgery from free into a priced, losing trade.
